title: Completa la frase
intro: [happy] Falta una palabra en cada frase. ¿Cuál es? Dila rápido.

english_phrases: There is a cat on the roof.

full_script: [happy] Falta una palabra en cada frase. ¿Cuál es? Dila rápido. There is a cat on the roof. There are three people in the room. Is there a bank near here? Ahora, nivel intermedio. There was a party last night. There were many people at the concert. There will be a meeting tomorrow. There has been an accident. Y ahora, nivel experto. There's no point in arguing. There used to be a cinema here. There's bound to be traffic. Tres aciertos, nivel básico. Siete, intermedio. Diez, experto de verdad. [excited] ¿Llegaste a la diez? Te leo en los comentarios.
